one_liner: CivicState turns civic concerns into paid, cited official letters; investibility remains unproven.
directive: Treat this as a watchlist EIR soul upgrade, not final adoption or investment approval.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: wrk.dog dispatch]; see the PR's POM record

methods: Compared registry identity against package/planning identity.
Separated implemented repo surfaces from unproven commercial claims.
Tagged external market claims as assumptions because network was unavailable.

planningMethod: Bottom-up EIR model: paid submissions x blended ASP, with explicit validation gates for demand, delivery, compliance, and operator posture.

customer.primary: US residents with specific civic concerns who want researched, formal letters sent to the correct officials [assumption: inferred from planning docs, not market-validated]
nonCustomers: Legal claimants seeking advice or filings [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Bulk advocacy organizations before policy review [evidence: .planning/raw-intake.md]
customer.validationGate: 25 paid campaigns by 2026-09-30, 3.0% conversion, 85.0% delivery success [assumption: EIR beta gate]

market.tam: USD 30,000,000 = 2,000,000 annual paid civic-letter events x USD 15.00 [assumption: no external research]
market.sam: USD 3,000,000 = 200,000 reachable events x USD 15.00 [assumption: initial reach constraint]
market.som: USD 180,000 by 2027-12-31 = 12,000 paid submissions x USD 15.00 [assumption: single-operator ramp]
market.freshness: Assumption-led as of 2026-06-23 [evidence: wrk.dog dispatch]; must be replaced with sourced data.

streams: Priority review [assumption: deferred stream from planning corpus]
API access for organizations [assumption: deferred stream from planning corpus]
businessModel.unitEconomics: USD 15.00 blended ASP, USD 2.20 variable COGS, 85.3% gross margin [assumption: EIR model]

revenueAssumptions: Paid conversion reaches 3.0% [assumption: unvalidated planning gate]
Refund and chargeback loss stays below 1.0% [assumption: EIR constraint]
costAssumptions: Backend droplet begins near USD 96 per month [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Variable COGS is USD 2.20 per paid job [assumption: no invoices]
Legal/compliance review budget is USD 25,000 in 2026 [assumption: risk budget]
sensitivityTests: Conversion at 1.0% lowers revenue by about 66.7% [assumption: linear funnel]
Variable cost at USD 4.40 lowers gross margin to 70.7% [assumption: unit model]
Delivery below 70.0% should pause paid launch [assumption: trust threshold]

alternatives: Manual outreach by email [assumption: substitute behavior]
Quorum and VoterVoice/Capitol Canary [assumption: enterprise competitors without network]

holes: Users may not pay before seeing official response.
Citation-backed drafting may create legal or trust risk.
Registry identity mismatch may mean this asset should not pitch as CivicState.
mitigations: Run paid beta before more feature work.
Use domain warming, bounce controls, and opt-out suppression.
Keep citation verification, disclaimers, and human review gates.
Require operator identity ruling before investor-facing use.

strategy: Narrow consumer paid civic-letter workflow first; defer organizations, subscriptions, public community mechanics, native apps, certified mail, and API products.

goToMarket.primary: Controlled beta and SEO-led public campaign pages [assumption: .planning/GENESIS.md hypothesis]
goToMarket.firstCustomers: First 100 paid customers from manual civic communities, operator network, SEO tests, and nonprofit/HOA interviews [assumption: EIR plan]
goToMarket.paidAcquisition: Deferred until CAC and conversion are measured [assumption: no analytics evidence]

operatorWorkflow.routine: Monitor flagged submissions, treasury, official opt-outs, bounces, and compliance requests [evidence: admin/compliance source files]
gates: Human review for threats, defamation risk, legal-adjacent claims, and bulk patterns [evidence: .planning/raw-intake.md]
Pause launch if delivery or legal controls fail [assumption: EIR gate]

constraints: Watchlist, not near-term investible BOS [evidence: wrk.dog registry notes]
No legal advice or claim filing [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
CAN-SPAM, CCPA/GDPR, AI disclosure, and citation verification constraints [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Workspace-only research in this run [evidence: wrk.dog dispatch]

aiWorkGovernance.disclosure: AI disclosure required in letters and product surfaces [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
aiWorkGovernance.citationPolicy: Unverified citations must be stripped or human-reviewed [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md]
aiWorkGovernance.humanReview: Flagged content goes to admin queue [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/submissions.ts, apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts]
